snippet.title: 💀 𝐇𝐞𝐫𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐌𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐌𝐚𝐠𝐢𝐜 𝐈𝐈𝐈 𝐂𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 — 𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐋𝐢𝐯𝐞 ⚔️
snippet.description:
The veil between worlds has shattered.

As you step into Antagarich, the silence of the grave breaks into war.
Undead legions rise beneath a darkened sky, and a hidden conspiracy begins to unfold across two realms.
From Adenthia to Antagarich, heroes who once fought separate battles now stand together against a common threat.

The Dragonheir & Heroes of Might and Magic III collaboration is officially live today.

🎬 Watch the launch PV to witness the beginning of this epic convergence—then enter the battlefield, uncover the truth behind the invasion, and experience the clash of legends for yourself.

🔥Return to Classic Strategy — Play Dragonheir Now:  https://dragonheir.sgrastudio.com/
#Dragonheir #HeroesOfMightAndMagic #HoMM3 #Collaboration
